# Counter khata — fictional design prototype

This static, local-only UI/UX concept explores a kirana shop's udhaar ledger.
All people, transactions and balances are fictional. No real money moves.
No messages are sent. There is no payment provider, backend, analytics or network API.
The QR illustration is decorative and contains no payment destination.

## Runtime interface

Startup calls exposeAgentTools(store) from the unmodified khata-core.js.
When document.modelContext or navigator.modelContext supports registerTool,
it attempts to register the six tools below. Settings reports the result.
window.counterKhata is also exposed:

  counterKhata.tools
  counterKhata.call('get_balance', { customerId: 'ravi' })
  counterKhata.call('add_credit', { customerId: 'ravi', amount: 250 })

The demo-added Ravi Shah has ID "ravi". Original core customer "c1" is Ramesh Kumar,
not Ravi. Other demo IDs: meena, arjun, sita, kabir, dev. Original IDs c1–c8 remain.
Consult agent-actions.json for exact names, descriptions, argument schemas and enums.

## Tools

- add_credit: add goods given on credit; increases the amount owed.
  Required: customerId (string), amount (number). Optional: note (string).
- record_payment: record received money; reduces the amount owed.
  Required: customerId, amount. Optional: method ("cash" or "UPI").
- get_balance: read outstanding balance for customerId.
- list_ledger: read entries and runningBalance for customerId.
- draft_reminder: draft English text only; never sends it.
  Required: customerId. Optional: tone ("gentle", "clear", "firm").
- hold_pending_upi: hold a NEW PURCHASE as pending credit; increases amount owed.
  Required: customerId, amount. Do not use this tool for an existing debt repayment:
  doing so adds that amount again. The UI layer tracks pending repayments separately.

## Data and limits

Actions affect fictional browser-local data. They do not communicate with anyone.
UI actions preserve cancelled entries via voidEntry; core undo() has different semantics
and is intentionally not used by the UI's five-second undo banner.
The supplied core's validation and number arithmetic are unchanged. This is not a
production accounting API. Use finite, positive amounts with at most two decimal places.
Raw API callers must validate their inputs. No authentication or remote endpoint exists.
The raw core does not include UI-only pending repayment records in list_ledger.
Settings can reset the demo. Judge scenarios also replace the fictional entries.
Real WebMCP support is browser-dependent; only a mock registration path and the plain
JavaScript API were verified in the included automated checks.

## Files

- README.md: Japanese setup guide, design choices, checked and unchecked behavior.
- agent-actions.json: exact AGENT_TOOLS array exported as JSON.
- khata-core.js: user-supplied, unchanged core.
- demo-data.js and app.js: fixtures, presentation, safe storage fallback and UI workflows.
- tests/: reproducible browser/core checks and their recorded results.
- shots/: actual headless Chromium screenshots, with dimensions in manifest.json.
